subject.title: fix(agents): load bootstrap files from agentDir alongside workspace

question: Should explicitly configured per-agent agentDir files become bootstrap prompt authority, or should OpenClaw keep workspace-only bootstrap loading and warn when agentDir contains ignored bootstrap filenames?
rationale: The code path is clear, but the open fixes choose different trust boundaries for security-critical AGENTS/SOUL instructions; automation should not decide which local directory supplies prompt policy.

options.title: Keep workspace-only and warn
options.body: Land the warning/docs path so misplaced agentDir bootstrap files are visible while the workspace remains the canonical prompt source.

options.title: Allow explicit agentDir prompt authority
options.body: Land this loading path only after aligning diagnostics, docs, upgrade compatibility, tests, and security proof.

options.title: Split mitigation from feature work
options.body: Ship warning-only diagnostics now and track per-agent agentDir bootstrap loading as a separate product/security design item.

recommendation.title: Keep workspace-only and warn
recommendation.body: Land the warning/docs path so misplaced agentDir bootstrap files are visible while the workspace remains the canonical prompt source.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger has the strongest current-history signal across bootstrap resolver, doctor diagnostics, and adjacent agent runtime surfaces inspected here.
